execute.description: create new table "_prisma_new_Source" with desired schema
execute.sql:
CREATE TABLE "_prisma_new_Source" (
  "configuration" TEXT,
  "createdAt" TEXT DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')) NOT NULL,
  "credentialCiphertext" TEXT,
  "id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "kind" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "lastSyncedAt" TEXT,
  "name" TEXT,
  "path" TEXT,
  "position" INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "sourceIdentity" TEXT,
  "updatedAt" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "url" TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  UNIQUE ("kind", "sourceIdentity")
)
